purpose: Waivers for undeclared strong dependencies that already existed when the structural check was introduced. The checker reports a violation only if it is absent here, so the gate fires on NEW structural debt instead of failing every commit on day one.
rules: Waivers are matched on the exact (plugin, missing_peer) pair. A baselined plugin that acquires a different undeclared peer is a new violation, not a covered one.
Nothing is added here automatically. Adding an entry is a decision to carry the debt, and it needs a reason and an owner.
Fixing a violation makes its entry stale; the checker names stale entries so they can be pruned deliberately.
source: ARCHITECTURE.json warnings as generated 2026-07-31 and committed at that state; regenerate and re-triage rather than trusting these counts after the map is refreshed.
